# `fixturepkg` package metadata fixture

This is a synthetic `Meta/package.rds`-shaped object for the fictional
`fixturepkg` package. It is generated by
[`generate_package_meta_fixture.R`](../../generate_package_meta_fixture.R)
with R 4.6.1 from hand-constructed data and contains no package source files.

Regenerate it from the repository root with:

```sh
Rscript crates/rd-rds/tests/fixtures/generate_package_meta_fixture.R
```
